title.justification: The title of the paper is "Lookback for Learning to Branch"

extractions.description: The paper introduces a method to improve deep learning enhanced Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) solvers by incorporating the 'lookback' phenomenon into GNN training, where a child node’s best choice was often the parent’s second-best choice. This approach decreases the size of the B&B tree and solving times.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: While the paper discusses optimization techniques that can be applied to various real-world problems, it doesn't explicitly focus on sustainable development as a central theme.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote:
Many real-world decision making problems are naturally formulated as Mixed-Integer Linear Programs (MILPs), for example, process integration (Kantor et al., 2020), production planning (Pochet & Wolsey,
2006), urban traffic management (Foster & Ryan, 1976; Fayazi & Vahidi, 2018), data center resource management (Nowatzki et al., 2013), and auction design (Abrache et al., 2007), to name a few
